decisions.reason: Because the firm is growing and has slack to continue experiments, it is likely to retain this startup accelerator for now, though its fit with the core machinery business is weaker than the other launches.

This binder extends the circularity logic of the firm but sits somewhat farther from its core plant-and-equipment offer, so it faces elevated review risk yet is still likely to be carried another year in a growth phase.
A decontamination plant is close to the established business, was prominently promoted at launch, and in a supportive innovation environment the firm has little reason to withdraw it so early.
This mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm’s core decentralized recycling strategy and should be kept unless results clearly disappoint, which is not indicated here.
